question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc084de5689a4e10a3553dd814b34e609514fb25d5b82b4b0194812cf70768e5.png]
solution:
Here, we use the figure (1) and (3) to find opposite faces, From the common number (1) written faces number in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/988c2ad11b2137a490bbe5d1783aefd93aa73f94d398d9b3a47f30b775908eb7.png] 

Here, the opposite of face showing 2 is face showing 5.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
